usedFor: Squarespace stores run on products and contacts, and “New Contact Is Added” starts a template when a contact appears.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Product with Variant” in Squarespace
bestTemplate.why: A product made elsewhere is created in Squarespace with a variant, so listings do not need retyping.

watchOut: “Delete Product” in Squarespace deletes a product, so check which one before it runs.
